sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Pawan Bhati, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP TANEJA Order 07/11/2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record.
The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.572/2022 of Police Station Subhash Nagar, District Bhilwara for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.
He has preferred this bail application under Section 483 of BNSS.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
Learned counsel has further submitted that the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate.
Learned counsel has also submitted that the petitioner is a 75 years' old aged person.

11853/2023 & 11854/2023 respectively.

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

Taking into consideration the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case, particularly the fact that the petitioner is a 75 years' old aged person, the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate,
co-accused persons have already been enlarged on bail and conclusion of trial of the case is likely to take time; but, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the petitioner under Section 483 of BNSS.

Accordingly, this bail application filed under Section 483 of BNSS is allowed and it is directed that petitioner - Heera Gurjar S/o Lalu Gurjar shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.572/2022 of Police Station Subhash Nagar, District Bhilwara, if not wanted in any other case,
